findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Debug console code execution
 * @description The debug console uses eval/exec which can execute arbitrary code
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/werkzeug-debug-console-code-exec
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("compile").getACall()
  ) and
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("%debug%")
select call, "Debug console uses code execution function which could be exploited if exposed in production."
findings.hypothesis: Debug console allows arbitrary code execution when enabled - checking for unsafe eval/exec usage in debug console

message.text: Debug console uses code execution function which could be exploited if exposed in production.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Use of weak cryptographic algorithms
 * @description Using weak cryptographic algorithms like MD5 or SHA1 for security purposes can be insecure
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/werkzeug-weak-crypto
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-327
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("hashlib").getMember(["md5", "sha1"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("random").getMember(["random", "randint", "choice"]).getACall()
select call, "Use of weak cryptographic function that may not be suitable for security purposes."
findings.hypothesis: Weak cryptographic algorithms like MD5, SHA1, or insecure random functions used for security purposes

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Information disclosure through debug output
 * @description Debug or error output that exposes sensitive information
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/werkzeug-info-disclosure
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-209
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("traceback").getMember(["print_exc", "format_exc", "print_exception"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("sys").getMember("exc_info").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("print").getACall()
  ) and
  exists(call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath()) and
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("%werkzeug%")
select call, "Potential information disclosure through debug or error output."
findings.hypothesis: Information disclosure through debug or error output that may expose sensitive system information
